press_references.value: AI credit disputing tool launches for consumers nationwide to correct credit report errors

product_launches.description: Kikoff launched AI Credit Disputes, an AI-driven tool in its app that helps users spot and dispute credit report errors. Rolled out nationwide on Aug 13, it is free for Kikoff users and has been used over 70,000 times since release.

press_references.value: Building a Legitimate, Profitable FinTech Unicorn Using AI: Cynthia Chen, Founder of Kikoff (Part 6) - Sramana Mitra

product_launches.description: Kikoff launched an AI-powered debt negotiator product that assists customers in negotiating debt settlements with lenders and debt collectors. The AI agent, trained on data from human experts, is now actively used and has achieved success rates comparable to human negotiators. The service is offered as a complimentary feature to Kikoff's credit-building members.

press_references.value: Debt Settlement Market Trends and Analysis by Application, Vertical, Region, and Segment Forecast to 2029

product_launches.description: Kikoff launched an AI-powered Debt Negotiator in April 2025 to automate repayment plans and creditor negotiations, targeting about 30% average debt reductions and easing borrower stress.

about_short_description.short_description: Kikoff provides credit building services through secured cards and rent reporting.

product.name: Kikoff Credit Account
product.description: A revolving line of credit for financing purchases from Kikoff, reported to all three major credit bureaus to build credit through on-time payments without interest or fees.

product.name: Kikoff Secured Credit Card
product.description: A secured Mastercard credit card that reports payment history to credit bureaus, helping users build credit through everyday purchases with a deposit-based credit limit.

product.name: Rent Reporting Service
product.description: A service that reports users' rent payments, including up to two years of past payments, to major credit bureaus to help build credit.

product.name: Credit Building Plans (Basic, Premium, Ultimate)
product.description: Subscription plans offering varying credit lines, credit bureau reporting, and additional features like rent reporting and identity theft protection to support credit building.

product.name: Privacy Protection Service
product.description: A service offering continuous monitoring and protection of users' personal data and credit information against cyber threats and data breaches.
